features: ZoomController.java integrated in BOTH modes (Player + Frame)
Pinch zoom, drag, fling, double-tap, mouse wheel
Settled (300ms) -> bicubic sharp crop (SharpScale.java Catmull-Rom)
Pan bounded by video edges, zoom limits 4x-12x, 1:1 always allowed
Zoom survives rotation, Fine Rotate, Picture Rotate, video change
Player double-tap = ±5s seek (kept from v2.4.5)
Frame double-tap = ±1 frame step (kept from v2.4.5)
Double-tap zoom disabled via flag (doubleTapZoomEnabled=false)
ColorGrade processing order FIXED: denoise -> sharpen(zoom-aware) -> colour
Denoise: 3x3 box blend, zoom-scaled (0.18 + 0.07*zoom)
Sharpen: unsharp on DENOISED pixels, strength shrinks with zoom (1.25 - 0.09*Δ, clamp 0.35..1)
GL fragment shader: Catmull-Rom bicubic (16-tap) when uZoom > 1.3
GL lifecycle fixes: onResume->glResume(), onPause->glPause(), surface recreate->reattachPlayerSurface
Original preset (0) = EXACT original pixels (no processing)
Settled crop also gets Quality Look applied
Sharpen strength decreases with zoom (less ringing on big crops)
